#### Creates the command line
Currently this is just the same from the Testing script
```{r commandlinegen}

#original command line from testing
# cmd1 = sprintf("%s -t %s -w %s -whdr %s -r %s",
#                      rhessys_ver, tecfile, worldfile, header, flowtable)
 # cmd2 = sprintf("-pre out/test -s 0.355794 651.390265 -sv 0.355794 651.390265 -svalt 1.083102 1.193924, -gw 0.116316 0.916922")
# cmd3 = sprintf("-st 1988 10 1 1 -ed 2000 10 1 1 -b -g")
# command_line = paste(cmd1,cmd2,cmd3)


rhessys_ver = "../../rhessys7.5" #new to point backwards to model
worldfile = "worldfiles/hpb2.world"
header = "worldfiles/hpb.hdr"
flowtable = "flowtables/hpb2.flow"
tecfile = "tecfiles/tec.test" 


cmd1 = sprintf("%s -t %s -w %s -whdr %s -r %s",
                     rhessys_ver, tecfile, worldfile, header, flowtable)
 cmd2 = sprintf("-pre out/HPBtest -s 0.355794 651.390265 -sv 0.355794 651.390265 -svalt 1.083102 1.193924, -gw 0.116316 0.916922")
 cmd3 = sprintf("-st 1908 01 1 1 -ed 2025 06 1 1 -b -g")
command_line = paste(cmd1,cmd2,cmd3)

system(command_line)


```

### Run RHESSys
```{r runrhessys}
system(command_line)
```

```{r}
#DWH trials 
names(hpb_test)
hpb_test_bd <- hpb_test$bd
hpb_test_bdg <- hpb_test$bdg

output <- left_join(hpb_test_bd, hpb_test_bdg, 
                    by = c("day", "month", "year", "basinID", "wy", "yd", "date")) |> 
  select(day, month, year, date, yd, wy, basinID, everything())
```

```{r}

## Biogeochem Plots
output |> 
  # filter(date > ymd("1950-01-01")) |> 
  select(date, year, yd, lai.x, #surfaceN, 
         litrc.x, plantc.x, soilc, streamflow_DON, streamflow_DOC
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(1:3)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value))+
  geom_point()+ 
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2)


## Hydro plots
output |> 
  # filter(date > ymd("1980-01-01")) |> 
  # select(date, year, yd, streamflow, baseflow, precip, recharge, unsat_stor, 
  #        rz_storage, sat_def, 
  #        litter_store, litter_capacity, 
  #        evap, evap_can, evap_lit, evap_soil,
  #        gw.Qout, gw.storage
  #        ) |> 
  select(date, year, yd, 
         streamflow,  precip, recharge, 
         unsat_stor, evap, gw.storage
         ) |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(1:3)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value))+
  geom_point()+ 
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2)


#streamflow by year
output |> 
  filter(wy > 2020) |> 
  select(date, year, yd, streamflow, precip) |> 
  pivot_longer(-c(1:3)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yd, y = value, color = as.factor(year) ))+
  geom_line(size = 1.2)+
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2)


#HPB watershed is 1.76 miles^2
#square miles to square meters = 1 square mile is 2.59e+6 square meters
#streamflow from model is in mm (mm to m ==  mm/1000)
rhessys_Q <- output |> 
  filter(year > 2020) |> 
  select(date, year, yd, streamflow, precip) |> 
  mutate(streamflow_cmday = (streamflow / 1000 ) * (1.76 * 2590000),
         streamflow_cms = streamflow_cmday / 86400
         ) |> 
  mutate(rhessys_Q_L_s = streamflow_cms * 1000)


left_join(rhessys_Q, ccr_flowmate, by = c("date" = "Date")) |> 
  filter(date >= ymd("2020-01-01")) |> 
  rename(Flowmate_L_s = L_s) |> 
  select(date, rhessys_Q_L_s, Flowmate_L_s) |> 
  ggplot()+
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = rhessys_Q_L_s), size = 1)+
  geom_point(aes(x = date, y = Flowmate_L_s), color = "red", size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Discharge (L/s)")

      
# left_join(rhessys_Q, ccr_flowmate, by = c("date" = "Date")) |>
```

## Look at CCR flowmate data

```{r}
#read in data
Qedi <- read.csv("https://pasta.lternet.edu/package/data/eml/edi/454/8/5edb79c2676d7b351d9eec184799c7dd")
qL1 <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CareyLabVT/Reservoirs/refs/heads/master/Data/DataNotYetUploadedToEDI/Raw_Discharge/ManualDischarge_L1.csv")

#filter to hpb
ccr_flowmate <- rbind(Qedi, qL1) |> 
  filter(Reservoir == "CCR", 
         #Site == 101,
         Site %in% c(100,101)
        ) |>
  mutate(DateTime = ymd_hms(DateTime),
          Date = as.Date(DateTime)) |> 
  mutate(L_s = Flow_cms * 1000) 


#plot of flowmate data 
ccr_flowmate |> ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = L_s))+ 
  geom_point()+ geom_line()



```
